use: That plan set a minimum setback of 75 feet for oceanfront houses.

struck: Each avenue was laid out to reach the sand, and those street ends are now public beach paths.

pattern: many (?:with|have) a garage apartment

struck: From 34th to 47th Avenue North, the city allows kayaks and surfboards in summer, which it bans on most of its beach.
use: From 34th to 47th Avenue North, the city allows kayaks and surfboards from May 1 through Labor Day, between 10 a.m. and 5 p.m.; it allows them at only five stretches of its beach.

pattern: is about a 9-minute walk\.?$
struck: Sea Captain's House, in a 1930 beach cottage, is about a 9-minute walk.

pattern: An HOA owns the common areas

pattern: its stage has free live music
struck: You can tie up a boat at its docks free for the day, and on fall weekends its stage has free live music.

pattern: so a show is close to home
struck: The Alabama Theatre and House of Blues are on the same grounds, so a show is close to home.

struck: Ocean Drive is where the shag grew up.

pattern: is free and tells the story of beach music and the shag

pattern: lake ringed by a half-mile walking path

pattern: Waties Island[^.]{0,120}with no public access

use: Across Hog Inlet, Waties Island has almost three miles of undeveloped beach.

pattern: where people once waited for the fishing boats to come in
struck: A large live oak stands over the riverfront at the end of Mineola Avenue, where people once waited for the fishing boats to come in.
use: A very large live oak dominated the riverfront at the end of Mineola Avenue, according to a 2001 state history.

pattern: has served dinner on the waterway since 1945
struck: Hurricane Juel's has served dinner on the waterway since 1945.
use: Hurricane Juel's has been family owned and operated since 1945, with a view of the waterway.

pattern: It was left as it was when it closed in 1932
struck: It was left as it was when it closed in 1932.

pattern: Most houses were built from 1970 to 2000
struck: Most houses were built from 1970 to 2000, and the busiest decade was the 1980s.

struck: Permitted golf carts may drive town streets in daylight, and the speed limit is 25.

pattern: (?:Each April brings a kite festival|kite festival each April)
